artifact_review: The Router underestimated the severity of structural issues indicated by the Pose Auditor. The Router noted a 'structural collapse' on a background bird (Severity 2.5), but the Pose Auditor flagged a HIGH risk (80% low-confidence keypoints) across multiple instances, including the central subject's hind limbs and face. The Perceptual Quality Auditor's low severity score (0.2) contradicts the Pose Auditor's findings; however, per protocol, structural/anatomical uncertainty (Pose) outweighs global perceptual smoothness. I am upgrading the artifact severity due to the high density of low-confidence keypoints indicating potential limb fusion or missing parts.

This correlates with the Router's observation of 'structural collapse' in the background. The central bird's feet are visually indistinct, supporting the hypothesis of minor melting/fusion. The ground texture also shows repetitive AI-noise patterns. These issues prevent a high artifact score despite the clean overall appearance.
